title: Final Judgment
definition: Final Judgment is God’s last and righteous judgment of all people through Jesus Christ.
summary: Final Judgment is God’s last and righteous judgment of all people through Jesus Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the appointed Judge and the Savior who bore judgment for His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Final Judgment places present life under the future God has promised. History will not end in moral confusion; god will judge every person with perfect truth and justice.

Scripture teaches the last things to produce hope, holiness, endurance, and urgency rather than speculation. Victims of evil need to know injustice will not be ignored, and sinners need to know judgment is real.

Christ stands at the center of this future. Jesus is the appointed Judge and the Savior who bore judgment for His people. Because of Him, believers can face death, judgment, suffering, and the future with sober confidence rather than fear.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
The coming future exposes what truly matters now. Victims of evil need to know injustice will not be ignored, and sinners need to know judgment is real. Scripture’s teaching about the last things steadies the heart in a world that feels unfinished.

It also guards the Church from fear-based prophecy and careless delay. The Lord calls His people to watchfulness, holiness, comfort, mission, and trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Flee to Christ, pursue holiness, and practice justice and mercy now. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
